- Don't design asynchronous systems if you want to sleep
    - huge [pita](https://xkcd.com/1671/) to debug

- $V_{IH}$ is lowest input voltage logical 1
- $V_{IL}$ is highest input voltage logical 0
- $V_{OH}$ is lowest output voltage logical 1
- $V_{OL}$ is highest output voltage logical 0
- Source and sink limits per pin vary (are not symmetric)
- `always_ff` makes errors (according to standard) when you don't imply a ff (which is not the case for `always`)
